Subject: Ostrem Bistro Group - Referral Required

Hi Tomas,

Thanks for the submission on Ostrem Bistro Group.

I've reviewed the information and unfortunately this risk requires referral to our senior underwriting team due to coastal exposure concerns. With 2 locations within 16 km of the coast and our existing portfolio concentration in that area already high, this falls outside my binding authority.

Given the coastal accumulation challenges we're facing, I'd recommend reaching out to a specialty market that focuses on coastal property risks—they'll likely be better positioned to provide competitive terms for this exposure.

I appreciate you thinking of us, and please don't hesitate to reach out with other opportunities that might be a better fit.

Best regards,

[Underwriter name]
